name: ilang-wechat-awesome
description: WeChat official account writing assistant. Feeds on your source material, restructures it with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, outputs publish-ready Markdown plus titles and a cover image prompt, and can push the approved draft into the WeChat draft box through the official API (draft box only, never publishes). Chinese-first. By iLang.

displayDescription.en: Feed it your source material and it restructures the piece with writing genes distilled from 200+ field-tested WeChat articles, runs a 12-point self-check with built-in de-AI editing, then outputs publish-ready Markdown, three titles and a cover image prompt while following WeChat content rules. One sentence pushes the approved draft into your WeChat draft box (never publishes). By iLang.
displayDescription.zh: 投喂素材出公众号文章：爆文结构重组，12项自查，内置去AI味，出正文、标题、封面提示词，可推草稿箱。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有素材，帮我按爆文结构写成公众号文章
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have source material, turn it into a WeChat article
